seo.title: Find a park that fits your group — Amusement Parks
seo.description: Compare documented parks for your group, date and preferences without an account or saved criteria.

parkFit.entryCta: Find a park for my group
parkFit.title: Which park fits your group?
parkFit.lead: Share only what matters for your day out. The compass compares sufficiently documented parks without turning unknowns into promises.

privacy.title: Your criteria stay on this screen
privacy.text: No name or account is required. The search is calculated without saving your group on the server.

date.title: Choose the date
date.text: A known closure excludes a park for that day. A date without published hours simply stays unknown.
date.label: Date of your visit
date.required: Choose a date to start the search.

group.title: Describe the group
group.text: One row per person is enough. Leave a field empty when you do not know the answer.
group.optional: Optional — a missing value will stay unknown.
group.accompaniedHint: Select this only when a companion can actually ride with them.
group.companionAgeHint: Optional. Without an age, some companion rules will stay unknown.
group.invalidMember: Check the height or age entered for this person.

preferences.title: Add your wishes
preferences.text: These choices guide the result order without automatically excluding other experiences.
preferences.indoorHint: Useful when you want a day out that depends less on the weather.

submit.title: Ready for a first lead?
submit.text: The result compares only parks that pass the minimum data-quality level.

feedback.invalid: Some criteria cannot be used. Check the group and date.
feedback.rateLimited: Too many searches were started in a row. Try again in a moment.
feedback.error: The engine is temporarily unavailable. Your criteria were not saved.

result.detailNext: Unknowns remain visible: this result helps your decision but does not guarantee access.

empty.title: No reliable park for these criteria
empty.text: The engine would rather promise nothing when a park is closed or insufficiently documented. Try another date or add more group details.

seo.title: Explained Park Fit results — Amusement Parks
seo.description: See which parks suit your group, the limits of each result, and the sources used.

results.title: Parks that suit your group
results.lead: For {{date}}, {{count}} sufficiently documented park(s) remain in the comparison.

reading.title: Read the reasons before the score
reading.text: The score only orders these parks against each other. It is neither a probability of success nor an access guarantee.

strengths.title: What works for your group
strengths.date: known situation on your chosen date

unknowns.title: Some facts are still unknown
unknowns.text: {{attractions}} attraction(s) and {{factors}} calculation factor(s) remain unknown. They are never counted as negative.
unknowns.clearText: The attractions and factors used for this result have the expected data.

limits.title: What limits or qualifies this result

score.title: Comparative score
score.notProbability: It orders parks for this same search; it does not predict your day out.

scoreReasons.HardFilterFailed: A required criterion is not met.
scoreReasons.DateUnavailable: The park is listed as closed on this date.
scoreReasons.CriticalDataExcluded: Critical data prevents this park from being compared.
scoreReasons.CriticalDataSuspended: Critical data needs checking before reaching a conclusion.
scoreReasons.NoKnownSubscore: No sufficiently known factor can produce a score.
scoreReasons.DataConfidenceUnknown: Overall confidence in the data remains unknown.
scoreReasons.IncompleteCoverageCapApplied: The score is capped because coverage is incomplete.
scoreReasons.DataConfidenceCapApplied: The score is cautiously capped due to data reliability.
scoreReasons.CriticalUnknownCapApplied: The score is capped because an important unknown remains.
scoreReasons.OptionalSubscoreNotApplicable: An optional factor you did not request does not lower the result.
scoreReasons.Unknown: An additional result limitation is not translated yet.

proofs.title: Evidence and freshness
proofs.text: These references support the access conditions used for your group.
proofs.noSource: No critical reference is needed to explain this result.

empty.title: No comparable result
empty.text: Closed or insufficiently documented parks are not presented as matches.

missing.lead: This page keeps results only while you navigate.
missing.title: Start with a search
missing.text: Private criteria and results are not stored in your browser or attached to an account.
